QueueLoom v1.5.8

Local diagnostics export

Choose Export diagnostics in Settings or beside an operation or updater error.
Review the readable report and structured JSON, then choose a new local ZIP file.
No diagnostics are uploaded, sent, or attached to GitHub automatically. Existing
files are never replaced.

Reports include bounded, recorded technical facts from the current session:
application and OS versions, architectures, broker and operation kinds, stages,
timestamps, safe error codes and application stack methods. Updater checksum and
recovery results are included when recorded. Unconfirmed outcomes remain unknown.

Collection excludes credentials, tokens, connection strings, message bodies and
headers, arbitrary exception messages, logs, configuration and local paths.
Broker addresses and entity references use report-local placeholders. Unknown
endpoints are omitted. Download progress preserves updater terminal diagnostics;
profile operations identify their captured target.

Review both previewed files before sharing publicly. Reports retain technical
context and are troubleshooting summaries, not complete audits or delivery proof.
